plugin.name: DPIA Workbench
plugin.description: Data Protection Impact Assessment: source tracing, fact confirmation, Q&A follow-up, risk & remediation, continuous re-assessment, and versioned reports. Adapted from Zhu Lingfeng's DSH DPIA Workbench; requires Node.js, Python, and LibreOffice.
plugin.author: AI WorkDeck (Upstream: Zhu Lingfeng / The-Data-Galaxy)
setting.nodePath.label: Node.js Executable
setting.nodePath.description: Leave blank to use node from system PATH; requires Node.js 20 or newer.
setting.pythonPath.label: Python Executable
setting.pythonPath.description: Requires document dependencies from runtime/requirements.txt; can specify a Python path from a virtual environment.
setting.pdfFontPath.label: PDF CJK Font File
setting.pdfFontPath.description: Filling CJK text in native PDF templates requires an embeddable TrueType font (TTF/TTC); leave blank to use system font lookup.
setting.sofficePath.label: LibreOffice Executable
setting.sofficePath.description: Only needed for report PDF export and page preview; leave blank to try default system locations.
tool.dpia_workbench_action.description: DPIA case, materials, fact confirmation, Q&A, run status, and report operations. For workbench UI only; AI must not invoke manual confirmation/approval entries.
tool.dpia_workbench_task.description: Execute currently frozen DPIA tasks: context/read/write/script/commit/report; strictly scoped to the current user project and case output directory.
